# Copilot Instructions

## Architecture Context

The full codebase architecture is documented in [src/merfolk.md](../src/merfolk.md) using Merfolk syntax — a 3D relational diagram language. This file is auto-generated by the `markdownDiagramService` and maps every component, hook, store, service, utility, and external dependency along with their relationships.

Use `src/merfolk.md` as your primary reference for understanding:
- Which components exist and their internal helper functions
- How hooks, stores, and services connect to each other
- Parent-child and containment relationships between modules
- External library dependencies

### Merfolk Syntax Quick Reference

**Node Types:**

| Syntax | Type | Geometry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A{Component: name}` | Component | Dodecahedron |
| `B[Function: name]` | Function | Cube |
| `C[[Store: name]]` | Store | Cube |
| `D((Service: name))` | Service | Tetrahedron |
| `E<Library: name>` | Library | Cube |
| `F[Hook: name]` | Hook | Cube |

**Connection Types:**

| Syntax | Type | Style |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `A --> B` | Data Flow | Solid arrow |
| `A -->\|"label"\| B` | Labeled Flow | Solid arrow |
| `A -.-> B` | Control Flow | Dashed arrow |
| `A --- B` | Association | Solid line |
| `A == B` | Inheritance | Thick line |

**Face Connections:** `A@front --> B@back` — connect to specific faces of 3D objects
- Cubes: `front`, `back`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`
- Dodecahedrons: `face_0` through `face_11`

**Flow Path Tracking:**
- `flowpath "name" : A --> B --> C` — define multi-hop data paths as a traceable unit
- `A --> B : "label" #flowName` — tag individual connections with flow path names
- Flow paths auto-create tagged connections between each adjacent pair of nodes

**Other:** `%%` — comment / section header

For the full syntax specification, see [merfolk-markdown-instructions.md](../merfolk-markdown-instructions.md).

## Tech Stack

- **UI**: React 18 with JSX (no TypeScript)
- **3D Rendering**: React Three Fiber + Three.js + @react-three/drei
- **State Management**: Zustand stores (see `src/stores/`)
- **Backend**: Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Storage, Realtime Database, Cloud Functions)
- **Build**: Vite
- **Spatial System**: Custom spatial partitioning with cell-based loading

## Key Conventions

- Components live in `src/components/`, hooks in `src/hooks/`, services in `src/services/`, stores in `src/stores/`, utilities in `src/utils/`
- State is managed through Zustand stores, not React context
- Firebase operations go through service modules, never called directly from components
- 3D objects (Cube, Dodecahedron, Tetrahedron, Plane, TextObject, ModelObject) are rendered via `ObjectsRenderer`
- Connections between objects are managed by `useConnections` hook and rendered by `ConnectionsRenderer`
- Spatial partitioning divides the 3D space into cells; objects load/unload as the camera moves
- Performance is critical — use `useCallback`, `useMemo`, refs, and throttling to avoid unnecessary re-renders
